meta.name: hyperframes-registry
meta.description: Install, discover, and wire registry blocks and components into HyperFrames compositions. Use when running hyperframes add or hyperframes catalog, installing one item or every block matching a tag, wiring an installed item into index.html, or working with hyperframes.json. Covers discovery, install locations, block sub-composition wiring, component snippet merging, and authoring a new block or component to contribute upstream (idea → scaffold → validate → PR).

copy.tagline: 安装、发现和编排 HyperFrames 组件块
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在用 HyperFrames 构建组合式前端应用
copy.tagline_en: Install, discover, and wire HyperFrames registry blocks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build composable frontend apps with HyperFrames

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你安装、查找并接入 HyperFrames 的 registry 块和组件：运行 hyperframes add 安装、hyperframes catalog 浏览目录、把已安装项接入 index.html、编辑 hyperframes.json，并支持创建新块/组件提交上游 PR。
howto.when: 当你要求运行 hyperframes add 或 hyperframes catalog，安装某个块/组件或匹配标签的全部块，把已安装项接入 index.html，或处理 hyperframes.json 时触发。

say.text: 帮我安装 data-chart 这个 block。
列出所有 social 标签的 block。
把刚安装的 grain-overlay 组件接进 index.html。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can install, discover, and wire HyperFrames registry blocks/components: runs hyperframes add to install, hyperframes catalog to browse, wires items into index.html, edits hyperframes.json, and supports authoring new blocks/components for upstream PRs.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to run hyperframes add or hyperframes catalog, install an item or all blocks matching a tag, wire an installed item into index.html, or work with hyperframes.json.

say_en.note: Runs hyperframes add data-chart and installs it.

say_en.text: List all blocks with the social tag.
Wire the installed grain-overlay component into index.html.
say_en.note: Guides adding data-composition-id and other attributes.
